limitations: Simulation demonstrations; friction and contact response are not hardware calibrated.
Original robot model retained, including disabled self-collision and collision/visual tire-width differences.
Controller uses privileged simulator contacts and world pose; not a sensor-only deployment controller.

render.sampling: nearest recorded physical state, no interpolation; exact initial and terminal poses
render.review_sampling_note: Half-second side-view snapshots plus exact terminal state; not a full-frame video audit.

visual_quality_rejection.reason: Extreme actual steering during a straight stair traversal is not an acceptable demonstration.
